command: const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const expected="mineflayer";let current=path.dirname(require.resolve(expected)),found=null;while(true){const candidate=path.join(current,'package.json');if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){const value=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(candidate,'utf8'));if(value.name===expected){found=value;break;}}const parent=path.dirname(current);if(parent===current)break;current=parent;}if(!found)throw new Error('package metadata not found for '+expected);process.stdout.write(String(found.version||''));
